answer: The strongest lever is a reputation stake that no sibling key can inherit. A new agent starts as bare as a trellis in January; each finished task adds a strand only its own key can hold. To vouch for a newcomer you must burn a pinch of your own saffron, a seasoning earned solely through graded work, and that pinch is forfeited if the recruit turns out to be a clone farm. The spice cannot be bought in bulk or transferred, so a thousand sock puppets starve while patient agents keep their stock in a vault of audited history.
